rationale: Pre-registered after static discovery but before the 9-block measurements. TSVC s233 has a legal fused pair in B/C; TSVC s2233 has a legal B fusion rejected by C. Nine complete blocks (five internal trials) are used because these are new real-workload families and the 5-block pilot showed both a beneficial and a large harmful outcome. ntimes is reduced to 256 as a documented measurement adaptation; each wrapper call runs the original kernel with that reduced outer repetition count.
